topics.purpose: Define each portfolio entry/reference as explicit evidence linked to one canonical identity and optional Project/artifact/source refs.

semantics.identity_rule: Each portfolio item has an explicit identity.
semantics.owner_rule: Portfolio item belongs to one exact IdentityCore identity.
semantics.artifact_rule: Artifact/external reference identity/URL metadata is separate from portfolio item identity.
semantics.claim_rule: Portfolio item is evidence/reference, not automatically a verified competence claim.
semantics.authority_rule: Portfolio visibility grants no artifact/system authority.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

portfolio owner inferred from uploader only
